metadata.label: Kickflip — captured body + local authored contacts [UNREVIEWED]
metadata.sourceAuthor: Original retargeted controls; The Berrics visual reference
metadata.rights: Original project reconstruction/retarget control data. Reference footage and pixels are not included or relicensed; no footage license is asserted.
metadata.provenance: Captured body retained; local flick, sole/upper-contact semantics, late foot clearance and soft landing are explicitly authored.
metadata.uncertainties: Reference filmed stance is uncertain; canonical Regular and its anatomical Goofy mirror are authoring mappings. Flick contact anatomy, hidden depth and Catch273 within blurred272–274 are authored.
metadata.authoredContactSemantics: Authored semantic markers, not measured confidence: rear-sole support ends at tail-pop259; front-sole support ends at260 before the ankle-roll. Upper-shoe nose-rim contact at261 is authored instep contact;262 is free carrier-space release, never sole support.
metadata.authoredKeyRepair: Captured torso/arms/head and source knee planes are the body basis. Short authored front upper-shoe/rear-foot contact repairs and late clearance are baked; early board pitch/lag and smooth landing height are authored. No claim that the previous all-body keys or board curve are unchanged.
metadata.bodyProvenance: Captured skeletal basis from captured-body.json; authored board and short local foot/contact constraints only.
metadata.rearSolePopCompliance: Attached rear sole matches the authored board through259, then C2 releases over one source frame into the same captured rear path/clearance. Old captured board pitch/arc is not treated as sole support for the new board.
metadata.authoredFreeAirDepth: Source266/267 images show a compact free-Air tuck. One C2 reconstructed-depth path pair is blended only262.5–272. The rear foot is higher while the tail rotates past it, then lowers to the compact source267 target. Captured torso/arms/head/hips, flick and Catch markers remain unchanged. Absolute target curves replace rather than add to the late clearance channel; hidden-depth reconstruction remains unreviewed.
metadata.authoredRearClearance: Short rear X/Z relocation retains captured hip-to-ankle distance; vertical target is solved from that distance instead of adding a fixed upward offset. Captured bend plane retained.
metadata.authoredCatchRecovery: Completed Catch pins feet over source272–273. Hip recovery starts at273 and reaches its authored landing envelope at277, retaining captured Catch extension before the impact bend.
metadata.authoredEarlyBoardClearance: Keys261/262 reduce the relative board lag to-.09m. Paired pitch and X/Z origin preserve the previous nose-rim position at both keys; this changes the tail path rather than adding a second flight arc.

sourceRootMotion.axes: Y-up, +Z nose; canonical Regular, anatomical Goofy mirror
sourceRootMotion.extraction: Subtract exactly upright translation [sourceBoard.origin.x,sourceBoard.origin.y-.092,sourceBoard.origin.z] from all joints. Directions unchanged. No inverse rolling-board rotation; no physical flight arc retained.
sourceRootMotion.runtime: Add actual physical upright carrier once to both body and authored board; do not add a second DeckTop.
sourceRootMotion.board: Independent authored carrier-local board pitch/lift, including a short early relative board lag; not the old captured board or its estimated root arc.
sourceRootMotion.bodyAfterSource278: Captured controls continue through real source296; no invented body frames or held-pose source cursor.

flickPatch.provenance: Original frozen companion upper/outside-forefoot support feature and real nose rim. Authored contact, not measured source pixels.
